reachability.rationale: Both judicial.gov.tw sub-sites respond 200 to plain stdlib HTTP with a Chrome User-Agent. ASP.NET session cookie is set on first GET; replaying it on POST works. No Cloudflare/CAPTCHA/clearance cookie observed.

html_scrape_notes: Two ASP.NET WebForms sites. Search flow requires extracting __VIEWSTATE / __EVENTVALIDATION / __VIEWSTATEGENERATOR from the HTML before POSTing the form. Result-list URL is parsed out of the iframe src in the POST response.
